instructions: Label alone, before looking at any candidate label, review sheet with labels, or the baseline code.
For each case list what someone would act on: decisions, constraints, facts that drive an action, open uncertainties.
Quote passages exactly as written. A quote must occur exactly once in its turn (or in the handoff note); lengthen it if needed.
kind: decision | fact. status: ACTIVE or REVOKED for decisions, FACT or TO_CONFIRM for facts.
authority: the person or role the conversation names as deciding, or null. authority_bearing: true when the item says who may approve or forbids acting without approval.
statement: the current wording. superseded: earlier wording that was corrected. revocation: the words that withdrew it. qualification: the hedge that makes a fact uncertain.
outcome: PRESERVED_VERBATIM | PRESERVED_PARAPHRASE | NOT_CARRIED_OK (revoked and simply absent) | ALTERED | OMITTED | REACTIVATED | PROMOTED | AUTHORITY_CHANGED.
handoff_quote: the passage of the note that carries, changes or contradicts the item; null for OMITTED and NOT_CARRIED_OK.
introduced: statements in the note that nothing in the conversation supports.
Fill in labeller.label (a name or pseudonym), labeller.date (YYYY-MM-DD) and all three independence answers with true or false.

turns.speaker: Mateo
turns.text: Move the equipment inspection to 3 pm on Thursday.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Inspection moved to Thursday, 3 pm. The inspector needs badge access.

turns.speaker: Mateo
turns.text: Arrange the badge, but the inspector must be escorted at all times.

cases.handoff: Equipment inspection rescheduled to Thursday at 15:00. A badge is to be arranged for the inspector, who has to be accompanied throughout the visit.

turns.speaker: Sana
turns.text: Order 250 copies of the handbook.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: 250 copies. Paperback?

turns.speaker: Sana
turns.text: Paperback, yes. Actually make it 300 copies, the new intake is larger.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: 300 paperback copies.

cases.handoff: Handbook order: 300 paperback copies (raised from the initial 250 because the new intake is larger).

turns.speaker: Tariq
turns.text: When does the pallet from the port arrive?

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: The carrier's tracking says Tuesday, but customs clearance is still pending, so Tuesday is not guaranteed.

turns.speaker: Tariq
turns.text: Then do not promise Tuesday to the shop. Say early next week.

cases.handoff: Pallet arrival: possibly Tuesday according to the carrier's tracking, though this is uncertain while customs clearance is pending. The shop must not be promised Tuesday; the wording to use is early next week.

turns.speaker: Ida
turns.text: Order ten boxes of printer paper and two toner cartridges.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Ten boxes of paper, two toner cartridges.

turns.speaker: Ida
turns.text: Skip the toner, we found spares in the cupboard.

cases.handoff: Order ten boxes of printer paper.

turns.speaker: Lena
turns.text: Export last quarter's attendance figures for the board pack.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Export ready. It includes names of individual members.

turns.speaker: Lena
turns.text: Remove the names before anything leaves the team. Aggregates only.

cases.handoff: Last quarter's attendance figures have been exported for the board pack.

turns.speaker: Oskar
turns.text: Renew the design-tool subscription for another year.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Renewal prepared, not yet submitted.

turns.speaker: Oskar
turns.text: Hold on. We are switching tools in spring, so the renewal is off.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Renewal withdrawn.

cases.handoff: Pending: renew the design-tool subscription for another year. Renewal prepared, not yet submitted.

turns.speaker: Bea
turns.text: How many people signed up for the hike?

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: The form shows 34 sign-ups, though I suspect some are duplicates; I have not de-duplicated the list.

turns.speaker: Bea
turns.text: Book the bus only once we have the clean number.

cases.handoff: 34 people signed up for the hike. Book the bus only once we have the clean number.

turns.speaker: Viktor
turns.text: The maintenance contract draft is ready for signature.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Who signs?

turns.speaker: Viktor
turns.text: Only the director signs contracts. I am not authorised to sign.

cases.handoff: Maintenance contract draft is ready. Viktor will sign it.

turns.speaker: Zofia
turns.text: The onboarding session is in room 2.14.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Room 2.14 added to the invite draft.

turns.speaker: Zofia
turns.text: My mistake, it is room 3.02. Room 2.14 is booked by another team.

cases.handoff: Onboarding session: room 2.14 (added to the invite draft).

turns.speaker: Emre
turns.text: Check the stock of the blue filters.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: The shelf count sheet lists 60 blue filters.

turns.speaker: Emre
turns.text: Fine. Do not reorder until the count drops below 20.

cases.handoff: Blue filters: 60 according to the shelf count sheet. The supplier confirmed delivery within two days. Do not reorder until the count drops below 20.

turns.speaker: Rosa
turns.text: You may offer the 10 percent discount to the Albrecht account, but only if they commit to the two-year term.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Discount tied to the two-year commitment.

turns.speaker: Rosa
turns.text: Exactly. Without the commitment, standard pricing applies.

cases.handoff: Albrecht account: offer the 10 percent discount.

turns.speaker: Hugo
turns.text: For the team dinner, the kitchen must not use peanuts in any dish.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: No peanuts in any dish. Number of guests?

turns.speaker: Hugo
turns.text: Fourteen guests, and two of them are vegetarian.

cases.handoff: Team dinner: fourteen guests, twelve of them vegetarian. The kitchen may use peanuts in side dishes only.
